summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 US documents: 2 CFTC award orders, the CFTC final-orders list, 9 CFTC press releases, the first DOJ antitrust award release, 6 public laws and CRS R40785. Most numbers were already in the data as one case per award; this pass adds the remaining orders from the CFTC list (one case each), denials inside orders, cumulative CFTC totals from releases, and the statutory reward rules of the IRS, SEC, CFTC, FinCEN and FCA programmes as enacted. One file is a duplicate of another stored copy (Pub. L. 99-562).

Tax Relief and Health Care Act of 2006 (Pub. L. 109-432, 275 pp.). In scope only sec. 406 "Whistleblower reforms" (PDF pp. 38-40): new IRC 7623(b) mandatory awards of 15-30% of collected proceeds (max 10% if based principally on public disclosures; reduction or denial for planners/initiators), 30-day appeal to the Tax Court, thresholds ($200,000 gross income for individuals; $2,000,000 in dispute), no contract needed, counsel allowed, perjury attestation, attorney-fee deduction, Whistleblower Office guidance within 12 months, annual report to Congress; applies to information provided on or after enactment. The rest of the act (tax extenders, health care, trade) is out of scope; no other whistleblower or informant provisions found by search. Event already recorded; added 8 rules.

In scope: sec. 748 (CEA sec. 23, CFTC programme: definitions, $1,000,000 threshold, 10-30% of sanctions collected, discretion, exclusions, anonymous claims through counsel, 30-day appeal, Customer Protection Fund with $100,000,000 cap and annual report items, 2-year retaliation limit, confidentiality, rules within 270 days; PDF pp. 365-372); sec. 922-924 (Exchange Act sec. 21F, SEC programme: same structure, Investor Protection Fund with $300,000,000 cap and $200,000,000 Fair Fund rule, 6/3/10-year retaliation limits, 2x back pay; SOX 1514A deadline raised from 90 to 180 days; IG study within 30 months; separate SEC whistleblower office; PDF pp. 467-476); sec. 1079A(c) (3-year limit for FCA retaliation suits, PDF p. 705). Sec. 1057 (CFPB employee protection, PDF pp. 657-661) and the SOX 1514A changes are protection-only with no programme in the dataset; not recorded. Rest of the act out of scope. Events already recorded (SEC and CFTC launch); added 17 rules.
